title: Pause-schedule validation checks list-order alternation but not at_ms order — an inverted pause/resume pair silently cancels the pause and u64-underflows the apply-tick lowering
detail: A `pause` at 70000ms followed by `resume` at 60500ms passes alternation; paused_at's last-wins loop never pauses, and ticks_stepped_by's hi-pe+1 wraps u64, shifting later commands' apply_ticks. Silently blesses a wrong T1.
recommended_fix: In parse_demo, track the last pause event's at_ms and reject a pause/resume whose at_ms is <= the previous event's (also reject at_ms beyond run_ms); mirrors the existing fail-loud arity/alternation checks.

title: Pause-aware wall-tick loop + stability check is duplicated verbatim between run_demo and replay_hashes (third variant in core/pause_test.odin)
detail: The virtual-clock loop (paused branch, per-window baseline reset, stability check) is copy-pasted into both drivers, plus a simplified third copy in core/pause_test.odin; future edits can touch one copy only.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared step-or-freeze helper (state, wall tick, sim_tick, pauses, hz) returning the hash + stability-failure string; call it from both loops so the pause semantics stay single-sourced.
